verdict.rationale: Gumroad publishes its web application source on GitHub and invites users to fork it, so the source is readable. Community reports say the license is not OSD-compliant and is better called 'source available', with free use allowed only up to $1M in revenue. That makes the 'open license' part of the story only partly met. Missing for 10: an OSI-approved open-source license, first-party documentation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This repository contains the source code for the Gumroad web application.
One user liked that Gumroad's code license allows use up to $1M in revenue before you must rebuild.
